targets.name: Barnard's Star
targets.blurb: The star with the fastest apparent motion in the sky: over 10 arcseconds a year, almost due north.

targets.name: Epsilon Indi Ba/Bb
targets.blurb: Two brown dwarfs (T1 and T6) orbiting each other, 12 light years from the Sun.

targets.name: WISE 0855-0714
targets.blurb: One of the coldest brown dwarfs known, 7.4 light years away and moving more than 8 arcseconds a year.

targets.name: RW Aurigae A
targets.blurb: A young multiple-star system in Auriga, about 510 light years away.

targets.name: R Draconis
targets.blurb: A pulsating red giant (a Mira variable) in Draco, roughly 2,600 light years away, that brightens and fades over months.

targets.name: WISEA J1101+5400
targets.blurb: The first brown dwarf found by Backyard Worlds volunteers, a T dwarf about 110 light years away.

targets.name: CWISE J0623+0715
targets.blurb: A cool T dwarf low in heavy elements (a subdwarf), flagged by Backyard Worlds and moving 1 arcsecond a year.

targets.name: CWISE J2112-0529
targets.blurb: A cool T subdwarf found through Backyard Worlds, moving 0.9 arcseconds a year.

targets.name: CWISE J2021+1524
targets.blurb: A faint, metal-poor L dwarf found through Backyard Worlds, moving 0.7 arcseconds a year.

targets.name: CWISE J0411+4714
targets.blurb: A late T dwarf with slightly low metal content, found through Backyard Worlds.

targets.name: CWISE J2029-7910
targets.blurb: A blue L1 dwarf found by volunteers as a wide companion to an M6 star.

targets.name: CWISE J1055+5443
targets.blurb: A nearby Y0 dwarf with unusual colours, about 22 light years away and moving 1.5 arcseconds a year.

targets.name: DENIS J0255-4700
targets.blurb: A nearby L9 brown dwarf, 16 light years away, moving 1.15 arcseconds a year.

targets.name: 2MASS J0559-1404
targets.blurb: A mid-T (T4.5) brown dwarf 34 light years away, moving 0.66 arcseconds a year.

targets.name: 2MASS J0415-0935
targets.blurb: A T8 brown dwarf 19 light years away with deep methane absorption, moving 2.3 arcseconds a year.

targets.name: UGPS J0722-0540
targets.blurb: One of the coolest T dwarfs (T9), 13 light years away, moving 1 arcsecond a year.

targets.name: WISE 1541-2250
targets.blurb: A Y dwarf about 20 light years away, much cooler than a T dwarf, moving 0.9 arcseconds a year.

targets.name: Haumea
targets.blurb: An egg-shaped dwarf planet beyond Neptune that spins once every four hours, coated in bright crystalline water ice.

targets.name: Makemake
targets.blurb: One of the brightest worlds in the Kuiper Belt, a dwarf planet covered in methane ice.
